title: The shot: A0 to A4, your R-7 and P-12 in the shoot house through the suit, drawn and played by the game's code
about: Your words of 2026-11-15: "Sound design is pretty weak, guns should bang harder and closer to realistic". v0.0.17's shot peaked high but its loudest 50 ms, what the ear hears as loudness, sat at -15.6 dBFS: a click with a tail. Each view draws one candidate's first 300 ms (your R-7 through the combat EVA suit's hearing filter, the room's answer and the game's master; your P-12 under it), the loudest 10 ms and 50 ms shaded with their levels. Open a view live (O) to hear it: Space or a click the R-7, P the P-12, B a burst of five. In play, the Esc menu's To score page switches the shot live in the house (and &shot=A0..A4 anywhere). The house plays A3 until you score; every other scene keeps A1, since you scored "Bang" on it.
